The PostgreSQL project contains several important areas such as query processing, storage management, transaction handling, concurrency control and so forth. The two primary directories to start exploring are `src/backend` which holds most of the server-side logic and `src/include`, where many header files defining core data types reside.

- **access**: Storage-related operations like buffer management and index access mechanisms.
